entities.name: Lhurgoyf
entities.description: Species of large reptilian scavenger creatures with elongated limbs and toothed mouths, found on Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane across which lhurgoyfs spread during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Era in which lhurgoyfs adapted to dwindling food by developing a carrion-based diet.

entities.name: Northland
entities.description: Arctic region of Dominaria where lhurgoyfs are now found.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Region of Dominaria where at least one lhurgoyf lived by the time of the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which a lhurgoyf was found in Urborg.

entities.name: Tarmogoyf
entities.description: Omnivorous lhurgoyfs that metabolize a variety of creatures and magics.

entities.name: Cantivore
entities.description: Lhurgoyf variety that derives power from magical energy.

entities.name: Magnivore
entities.description: Lhurgoyf variety that derives power from emotions.

events.summary: Lhurgoyfs spread across Dominaria during the Ice Age, adapting to a carrion diet, and later migrate north to the Northland.
events.quote: Lhurgoyfs spread across Dominaria during the Ice Age

events.summary: At least one lhurgoyf is found in Urborg by the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: at least one lhurgoyf was to be found in Urborg

relations.note: now found in the arctic Northland
relations.quote: they migrated north and are now found in the plane's arctic Northland
